title: Distribute Candies to People
summary: Distribute candies to a row of num_people people by initially giving 1 candy to the first person and increasing the number of candies by 1 for each subsequent person until the end of the row is reached.
statement: Distribute candies to a row of num_people people by initially giving 1 candy to the first person and increasing the number of candies by 1 for each subsequent person until the end of the row is reached. Then, start again from the first person with an increased count of candies (starting from n+1 where n is the number of people), continuing this process until all candies are distributed. The last person will receive any remaining candies. Return an array representing the final distribution of candies among the people.
constraints: Give 1,2,3,... candies cyclically until none remain.
A final partial gift goes to the current person.
hints: Direct simulation is bounded by roughly the square root of the candy count.
Track the next gift size and cycle person modulo numPeople.
Give min(scheduled,remaining), update totals, and stop at zero.
Each iteration reproduces exactly one gift specified by the process.
editorial: Each iteration reproduces exactly one gift specified by the process.

tests.explanation: Gifts 1,2,3, then the remaining one produce 1,2,3,1.
